notablePrerequisites: Chulane does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Cast Sage of Hours by paying {6}{U}.
Chulane triggers, causing you to draw a card and allowing you to put a land from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve Sage of Hours, causing it to enter the battlefield with five +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you take at least one extra turn after this one.
Activate Chulane by paying {3} and tapping it, returning Sage of Hours from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat each turn.
